Kiba flows through every world: it can nourish or destroy. Around Japan's shrines it gives life; among the ruins it fades. Momo follows its currents in search of Haru.
dict.text.in.yomi.kiba.is.dense.and.distorted: In Yomi, Kiba is dense and distorted. Cultists and demons draw destructive power from it; Momo can learn to dash through its shadow current.
In heaven, Kiba is stronger, yet its balance is fragile. It feeds the wind streams, while the corrupted guardian shapes both light and shadow from it.
dict.story.japan.intro: Kiba's nourishing current is strongest in the living world. Two distant bells guard Haru's trail. One waits in the forest canopy, the other on the rooftops of a quiet village. Head east, visit the wind shrine, and explore paths above and beneath the river. The two bells together open the Bamboo Temple.
dict.story.yomi.intro: In Yomi, Kiba becomes distorted: its nourishing force turns to destructive lava and shadow. Yomi stretches below you. Descend along the well's ledges: two captive souls keep the gate at the bottom sealed. Defeat their captors, then press E to free them. The Shrine of Shadows lies halfway down. S + Space: drop through a ledge. Use the map to travel to discovered shrines.
dict.story.heaven.intro: In heaven, Kiba is rare but pure; it suddenly surges through the wind streams. Haru waits above the clouds. Your path leads upward: jump into the glowing wind streams and let them lift you. Move sideways onto cloud islands, then continue climbing with double-jumps and Spirit Dash. Break the uppermost seal with J. Your father's altar lies above the final guardian.
dict.menu.kiba.lore: Kiba flows through every world: it nourishes, fades, or twists into destruction.

dict.help.title: How to Play
dict.help.move.title: Movement and jumping
dict.help.move.body: Explore each realm, jump onto ledges, and use a second jump in midair after gaining the wind blessing. You can also drop through stone and cloud ledges.
dict.help.fight.title: Combat and training
dict.help.fight.body: Watch enemy attack tells, strike with your sword, and use Spirit Dash once you have earned it. Defeated enemies grant XP; shrines let you heal and spend training points.
dict.help.journey.title: Three realms, three routes
dict.help.journey.body: Find the two bells in Japan, free the captive souls in Yomi, and ride the wind streams in heaven. The map lets you travel to discovered shrines. Use torii gates while standing on the ground.
dict.help.bindings.title: Key bindings
dict.help.bindings.body: Choose a layout, then select an action key to rebind it. Custom changes are saved in this browser and can also be exported or imported as JSON.

dict.prologue.wake.title: The village is under attack
dict.prologue.wake.story: Momo wakes, gasping. The black hole, the violet eyes, the shadow that consumed him — it was all a dream. Then a scream tears through the dawn. Soldiers have attacked the village. Haru is nowhere to be found. Momo grabs his sword and rushes onto the path. He must find his father.
